## Separate complete bounded source control for live member, owner scope, rollback, and managed state.
app MemberControl
Given
 Account { name:text="account" }
 Job { title:text="test", count:int=1, enabled:bool=true, account:Account?, status:enum(idle,queued,ready)=idle machine }
 policy Account read=public
 policy Job read=public
When
 crud Account by=members fields=name
 crud Job by=members fields=title,count,enabled,account
 scenario advance(job:Job) by=members
  do
   transition job.status idle -> queued
   transition job.status queued -> ready
 scenario lateFail(job:Job,accept:bool) by=members
  do
   transition job.status idle -> queued
   require accept
 scenario ownerGate(accept:bool) by=owner
  do require accept
Then
 page / title="Member control"
  list Job
   text row.title,row.status
